# Attach libraries
require(dplyr)

line.color = "black"
bkg.plot = element_blank()

                   axis.line = element_line(arrow = grid::arrow(type = "closed", ends = "last"), color = line.color),
                   axis.ticks = element_blank(),
                   axis.text = element_blank(),
                   axis.title = element_text(hjust = 0.90, color = axis.text.color),

1 Filter data

1.1 Load data

xenium -> SeuratObject::UpdateSeuratObject(readRDS("./xenium_all_TMAs_combined.Rds"))


1.2 Filter

meta <- xenium[[]]

is_major_not_cancer <- meta$Major_cell_annotation %in% c("T-cells", "Myeloid", "Plasmablasts", "B-cells")
is_minor_tme <- meta$Minor_cell_annotation %in% c("B cells Memory", "B cells Naive", "Cycling T-cells", "NK cells",
                                                     "NKT cells", "T cells CD4+", "T cells CD8+", "Plasmablasts",
                                                     "Cycling_Myeloid", "DCs","Macrophage", "Monocyte")


is_major_not_cancer = meta$Major_cell_annotation != "Cancer Epithelial"
is_minor_not_cancer = !grepl("Cancer", meta$Minor_cell_annotation)
is_minor_not_breast = !(meta$Minor_cell_annotation %in% c("Luminal Progenitors",
                                                          "Mature Luminal",
                                                          "Myoepithelial"))

# check how the two levels agree before choosing AND or OR
table(major.not.ca = is_major_not_cancer,
      minor.not.ca = is_minor_not_cancer,
      minor.not.bca = is_minor_not_breast)

keep <- is_major_not_cancer & is_minor_not_cancer & is_minor_not_breast  # all levels agree (stricter)

xenium <- SeuratObject::UpdateSeuratObject(xenium)
xenium_tme <- subset(xenium, cells = rownames(meta)[keep])
## An object of class Seurat 
## 5001 features across 312139 samples within 1 assay 
## Active assay: Xenium (5001 features, 5001 variable features)
##  3 layers present: counts, data, scale.data
##  2 dimensional reductions calculated: pca, umap
##  4 spatial fields of view present: TMA13 TMA15 TMA17 all_TMA_display


1.3 Dimensional reduction

xenium_tme <- ScaleData(xenium_tme)
xenium_tme <- RunPCA(xenium_tme, npcs = 50)
ElbowPlot(xenium_tme, ndims = 50)          # pick the number of PCs from this

xenium_tme <- FindNeighbors(xenium_tme, dims = 1:50, k.param = 16)
xenium_tme <- FindClusters(xenium_tme, resolution = 0.5)
xenium_tme <- RunUMAP(xenium_tme, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

xenium_tme

2 UMAPs

2.1 By cell type

n_cells = nrow(xenium_tme@meta.data)

umap_tme_tissue_MNr =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium_tme,
                  group.by = "M.nr",
                  raster=T,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_mnr,
                     breaks = names(colors_mnr)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**TME cells | Patient**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme
  


umap_tme_tissue_types =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium_tme,
                  group.by = "Tissue_type",
                  raster=T,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_tissue_type,
                     breaks = names(colors_tissue_type)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**TME cells | Tissue origin**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme


umap_tme_cell_types_minor =
  Seurat::DimPlot(xenium_tme,
                  group.by = "Minor_cell_annotation",
                  raster=T,
                  raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
  xlab("UMAP1") +
  ylab("UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_cell_type_minor,
                     breaks = names(colors_cell_type_minor)) +
  ggtitle(label = "**TME cells | cell type (minor)**",
          subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
  umap_theme

all_umaps = 
  patchwork::wrap_plots(umap_tme_tissue_MNr,
                        umap_tme_tissue_types,
                        umap_tme_cell_types_minor,
                        nrow = 1)
all_umaps


2.2 Gene expression

min.cutoff = "0"
max.cutoff = "q90"

genes_to_plot = c("CD4 (T-helper)" = "CD4",
                  "CD8 (T-cytotoxic)" = "CD8A",
                  "CD20 (B-cells)" = "MS4A1",
                  "CD14 (macrophages)" = "CD14")
                  
umap_gene.exp_tme = list()

for (i in 1:length(genes_to_plot)) {
  umap_gene.exp_tme[[i]] =
    Seurat::FeaturePlot(xenium_tme,
                        features = genes_to_plot[i],
                        min.cutoff = min.cutoff,
                        max.cutoff = max.cutoff,
                        cols = expression_palette,
                        keep.scale = "feature",
                        raster=T,
                        raster.dpi = c(800,800)) + # geom_scattermore() for rasterization
    xlab("UMAP1") +
    ylab("UMAP2") +
    ggtitle(label = paste0("**TME cells | ",names(genes_to_plot)[i],"**"),
            subtitle = paste0("*n* = ", prettyNum(n_cells, big.mark = ","))) +
    umap_theme
}

patchwork::wrap_plots(umap_gene.exp_tme, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
